title: Mitochondrial Isolation SOP
author: Elena Pumbo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfr7jm9n
materials: ·After liquid nitrogen evaporate mortar is cold enough.
·Put mortar and pestle aside to warm up.
·Adjust balance volume to new sample volume.

steps.title: Prepare Equipment and Reagents
steps.instruction: Set up the centrifuge and cooling materials.

substeps.instruction: Cool down centrifuge and Rotor F-35-6-30 (for 6 x 50 mL and 5 x 15 mL tubes) to +4 °C.
Prepare a 1 L liquid nitrogen container with liquid nitrogen.
Cool a metal spatula and a 50 mL conical tube on dry ice.
Fill a mortar with liquid nitrogen and cool the pestle on dry ice.

steps.title: Prepare Frozen Liver Tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh and grind the frozen mouse liver tissue.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve livers from -80 °C freezer and place on dry ice.
Weigh a 10x10 cm square of aluminum foil using a Mettler Toledo Analytical Balance.
Place up to 15 gm of unwrapped frozen livers (approx. 10 livers) on the foil.
Place one frozen liver in the mortar and add liquid nitrogen up to 1/2 mortar volume.
Wrap the pestle and mortar with paper towels to avoid frostbite.
Grind liver until it becomes powder.
Transfer the ground tissue into the pre-cooled 50 mL tube using the cold spatula.
Repeat for all livers.
Weigh the total ground tissue using the Mettler Toledo Analytical Balance.

steps.title: Tissue Lysis and Homogenization
steps.instruction: Lysis and homogenize the liver powder.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 10 gm of ground liver powder into a fresh tube (subtracting the weight of the empty tube).
Add Tissue Lysis Buffer up to 50 mL.
Wait for tissue to thaw, vortexing occasionally.
Aliquot the thawed tissue into 25 Matrix A 2 mL tubes for the MP Homogenizer using transfer pipettes.
Run the MP Homogenizer according to the on-screen instructions.
Place homogenized tubes on regular ice after the program finishes.
Transfer the homogenate from Matrix A tubes into a fresh 50 mL tube using a transfer pipette.

steps.title: First Centrifugation Cycle
steps.instruction: Perform initial slow and fast centrifugation to isolate the first supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the 50 mL tube with homogenate and a balance tube into Rotor F-35-6-30.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C (Slow Centrifugation 1).
Transfer the supernatant into a fresh tube and label as 'Supernatant 1'.
Place the remaining tube back into Rotor F-35-6-30.
Centrifuge at 7830 rpm for 20 min at 4 °C (Fast Centrifugation 1).
Remove the tube and place on ice.
Use q-tips to remove white fat floating on top of the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 25 mL of Tissue Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Second Centrifugation Cycle
steps.instruction: Perform second slow and fast centrifugation to isolate the second supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Place the 50 mL tube and balance into Rotor F-35-6-30.
Centrifuge at 2000 rpm for 10 min at 4 °C (Slow Centrifugation 2).
Transfer the supernatant into a fresh tube and label as 'Supernatant 2'.
Place the remaining tube back into Rotor F-35-6-30.
Centrifuge at 7830 rpm for 20 min at 4 °C (Fast Centrifugation 2).
Remove the tube and place on ice.
Use q-tips to carefully remove fat floating on top of the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 12 mL of Tissue Lysis Buffer.

steps.title: Wash Centrifugation
steps.instruction: Wash the pellet and prepare for cell lysis.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the resuspension into 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Change the centrifuge rotor to Rotor FA-45-48-11 (for 48 x 2 mL tubes).
Centrifuge at 12700 rpm for 20 min at 4 °C.
Remove tubes and place on ice.
Resuspend pellets in 5-6 mL of Tissue Lysis Buffer and transfer into a 15 mL conical tube.
Reinstall Rotor F-35-6-30.

steps.title: Mitochondrial Pellet Lysis
steps.instruction: Treat the mitochondrial pellet with Cell Lysis Buffer and Triton X-100.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 10 mL of Cell Lysis Buffer containing 1 tablet of Proteinase Inhibitor (PI) cocktail.
Add up to 5 mL of this Cell Lysis Buffer to the mitochondria pellet using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Add 50 µL of Triton X-100 using a 200 µL pipettor and tip.
Pipette up and down 20 times to ensure all Triton X-100 is dispensed.
Incubate for 15 min at 4 °C (in cold room) with rotation.

steps.title: Final Recovery
steps.instruction: Perform final centrifugation to recover the sample.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 2 mL of the mixture into fresh 2 mL microcentrifuge tubes.
Change the rotor to Rotor FA-45-48-11 (for 48 x 2 mL tubes).
Centrifuge (parameters not specified, but implied by context) and place tubes on ice upon completion.
